later_review_audit.description: pyenv’s python-build helper verifies supplied checksums, including SHA-256 values in versioned python-build definitions, and returns failure on mismatch.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; release signing for toolchain archives is outside this review.
The claim is limited to checksum enforcement and does not establish a publisher signature.

original_evidence.text: | pyenv | https://github.com/pyenv/pyenv.git | 234a87e / 2026-08-16 | Y | N | Y | https (`www.python.org/ftp`), TLS enforced | N | **hash (SHA256)**, pinned in versioned repo source | pinned-in-repo (git-shipped definition files) | `pyenv/plugins/python-build/bin/python-build:363-396` `verify_checksum()`; e.g. `pyenv/plugins/python-build/share/python-build/3.12.0` — `install_package "Python-3.12.0" "https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.12.0/Python-3.12.0.tar.xz#795c34f4...` — checksum embedded in the definition file shipped with the clone, not fetched at runtime. python-build (and pyenv-binary, same pattern — see `pyenv/plugins/pyenv-binary/libexec/pyenv-binary-generate-installer:95-127`) are vendored plugins, so pyenv itself ships install capability. |
